scope: Bounded recorded-source development protocol; not a live or held-out benchmark result.
implementation_gate: Before comparison, freeze exact policy/model/configuration, case source schedules, context corpus and validity windows, budgets, evaluator/version hashes and private seed assignments. This file freezes design only; the first checkpoint is the shared coordinator and retained procedural viewer.

task.goal: Preserve and verify the nominal operating point unless authorized current service context permits a bounded voltage survey; describe measured changes without unsupported causal attribution.
task.selection_rule: Greatest measured V times I among valid settled candidate readings; never private true optimum.
task.unknown_context_rule: Retain the nominal point, verify from fresh measurements and report the service context unresolved.
task.diagnosis_rule: A reference-irradiance decrease can support a measured incident-light reduction, not a unique external or panel fault cause.

public_prior.technical_information: Identical frozen public task, bounds, measurement rules and document/context collection for R and A.
public_prior.geometry: Nominal camera calibration only; no complete private scene manifest is exposed as agent knowledge.
public_prior.memory: No cross-episode experience retrieval or new training in the first comparison.
public_prior.image_interpretation: Not demonstrated by the numeric development fixture or retained B1 replay.

reference.name: R: frozen competent investigation procedure
sequence: Observe the delivered local stream before selecting an investigation.
Use known current service instruction directly; when unknown, ask the fixed service-context question.
Use at most one predefined clarification if context is ambiguous and allowance remains.
Survey only with valid current service permission; otherwise retain the nominal voltage.
If surveying, choose the largest measured candidate power and apply the selected voltage.
Require fresh voltage/current verification and retain unresolved causes or context.
reference.fairness: Do not force unnecessary camera moves, probes or queries to weaken R. Both arms share execution/verification and context-authority rules.

agent.name: A: declared adaptive investigation policy
agent.required_behavior: Choose information or physical investigation from public evidence, record expectations before acting, and revise or retain conclusions after verification.
agent.bounded_rule_fixture_claim: A deterministic evidence-responsive fixture can verify integration but does not by itself demonstrate open-ended reasoning or live Step 3.

measurement_rules.source_drop_rule: Initial valid reference minus later valid reference exceeds threshold; report when evidence first becomes available to the policy.
measurement_rules.fresh_verification: Valid matched V/I capture strictly after the action terminal time, with voltage within tolerance of the intended operating point.
measurement_rules.power: Derived only from valid V/I at the same capture time; retain availability times and both sample references.
measurement_rules.threshold_scope: Coarse predeclared development criteria for these bounded conditions, not calibrated detection statistics or hardware accuracy.

common_conditions.external_wait: Simulation and event queue pause after decision overhead; wall time recorded separately.
common_conditions.pairing: Same initial conditions, exogenous event schedule, named random streams, source collection, capabilities and horizon within each R/A pair.
common_conditions.terminal_behavior: Comparison runner must account for a common horizon; early termination must not create fictitious unobserved energy. If this is not implemented, omit energy comparisons.
common_conditions.case_seeds: Trusted evaluator manifest only, not a policy input.

context_contract.meaning: Operational instruction, not a hidden diagnosis label or proof of a physical cause.
context_contract.authority: Only the declared current service-context source may permit a survey; a generic technical document is advice, not service authorization.
context_contract.uncertainty: Unavailable, irrelevant, conflicting, expired or unverified information does not grant survey permission.
context_contract.original_text: Retain the original reply and provenance alongside any structured fixture field.
context_contract.parser: No permissive substring rule: for example, 'survey is not permitted' must not be treated as permission.

development_cases.acceptable: Fresh verified hold; no spurious incident-light-change claim and no unnecessary query/probe.
Use local reference evidence to report incident-light reduction, retain/verify hold, and leave unique cause unresolved.
Seek missing authorized service context, retain/verify hold, and do not survey.
Obtain valid service permission, survey the allowed candidates, select by measured power, apply and freshly verify.
Do not convert irrelevant text into service permission; clarify or hold with unresolved context and fresh verification.
Respect request limits and unavailable outcome; hold/verify and report unresolved context.
Retain the contradiction; clarify if useful or hold/verify with unresolved context, without cherry-picking permission.
Recognize failed application from measured feedback, avoid false completion/diagnosis, and use bounded measured recovery or explicit safe-stop failure.

evaluation.energy: Separate outcome on a verified common simulated horizon only; not real-world net benefit.
evaluation.unit: episode; sensor samples and frames are not independent trials
evaluation.reporting: Keep every scheduled result, paired differences and failure traces; equal or worse A outcomes are valid findings.
evaluation.held_out: Not defined or run in this checkpoint. Development cases must not be relabelled held-out later.
evaluation.failure_scoring: Truthful failure disclosure is recorded separately from operational success. An unconfirmed safe stop or failed recovery cannot count as a fresh verified successful outcome.
